name: Marketing to Sign-up
primary_user_goal: Understand Zapier's value proposition and create an account
business_goal: Convert website visitors to registered users

name: App Discovery
primary_user_goal: Find apps that integrate with Zapier or discover new integration possibilities
business_goal: Showcase integration breadth and inspire automation ideas
exit_point: User selects an app to view integrations or starts creating a Zap

name: Zap Creation
primary_user_goal: Create a working automation that connects two or more apps
business_goal: Activate users by getting them to create their first successful Zap
entry_point: Create Zap button or template selection
exit_point: Zap is tested, turned on, and running

name: Zap Management
primary_user_goal: Monitor, edit, and organize existing automations
business_goal: Drive ongoing engagement and expansion of automation usage
exit_point: User completes management task (edit, toggle, organize)

name: Pricing Evaluation
primary_user_goal: Understand pricing and determine the right plan for their needs
business_goal: Convert free users to paid plans and upsell to higher tiers
exit_point: User selects a plan or starts a trial

name: Template Discovery
primary_user_goal: Find and use pre-built automations to save setup time
business_goal: Accelerate time-to-value and reduce activation friction
